title: Exact augmented face complex for an injective sheaf on a total simplicial site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C_\bullet$ be a simplicial diagram of small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] and morphisms of sites. For $\alpha:[p]\to[q]$ write $u_\alpha:\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_q)\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_p)$ for its geometric transition morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. Let $a_p:\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_p)\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ be an augmentation to a small site, with coherent identifications $a_q=a_pu_\alpha$; identity and composition laws may hold through specified isomorphisms satisfying the cocycle identities. The total site has componentwise coverings, and its sheaves are families $F_p$ with transition maps $u_\alpha^{-1}F_p\to F_q$ satisfying identity and composition. Write $a$ for the induced total augmentation, so $(a^{-1}G)_p=a_p^{-1}G$. Let $I$ be an injective abelian sheaf on this total site [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Set $C_a(I)^p=a_{p,*}I_p$ for $p\ge0$ and $\delta^p=\sum_{i=0}^{p+1}(-1)^i d_i$, where $d_i$ is induced by $I_p\to u_{i,*}u_i^{-1}I_p\to u_{i,*}I_{p+1}$ and $a_{p+1}=a_pu_i$. Let $e_I:a_*I\to a_{0,*}I_0$ be adjoint to the degree-zero component $a_0^{-1}a_*I\to I_0$ of the counit. Then the sequence of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal D$
$$0\longrightarrow a_*I\xrightarrow{e_I}a_{0,*}I_0\xrightarrow{\delta^0}a_{1,*}I_1\xrightarrow{\delta^1}a_{2,*}I_2\longrightarrow\cdots$$
is a complex and is exact in every degree. This augmented complex is natural for morphisms of injective abelian sheaves on the total site. No covering or hypercover condition on the augmentation, and no cartesian-transition condition on $I$, is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0D79, lemma-augmentation-cech-complex, injective case and its Hom-adjunction construction.

proof.text: Fix an abelian sheaf $G$ on $\mathcal D$. For each $p\geq0$ let $E_p=g_{p!}(a_p^{-1}G)$, where $g_{p!}$ is the exact left adjoint to restriction to the $p$-th component, and let $E_0\to a^{-1}G$ be adjoint to the identity of $a_0^{-1}G=r_0a^{-1}G$. For $p\ge0$ and $0\le i\le p+1$ let $d_i:E_{p+1}\to E_p$ be adjoint, under $g_{p+1!}\dashv r_{p+1}$, to the inclusion of $a_{p+1}^{-1}G$ as the factor labelled $\delta_i:[p]\to[p+1]$ of $r_{p+1}E_p=\bigoplus_{\varphi:[p]\to[p+1]}a_{p+1}^{-1}G$, and give the resolution the boundary $\sum_i(-1)^id_i$. In component degree $m$, the restriction of $E_p$ is $\bigoplus_{\alpha:[p]\to[m]}a_m^{-1}G$, and the alternating face maps are the usual boundary maps of the free simplicial abelian sheaf on the standard simplex $\Delta[m]$. The extra-degeneracy $h(\alpha)(0)=0$, $h(\alpha)(j+1)=\alpha(j)$ gives the contracting-homotopy identity $dh+hd=1-\eta\epsilon$ (with the evident augmentation in degree zero). Hence the augmented complex is exact after every component restriction. Exactness and joint conservativity of the component restrictions imply that $\cdots\to E_2\to E_1\to E_0\to a^{-1}G\to0$ is exact. The simplicial identities also give that its alternating differential squares to zero.

source.place: Tag 0D79 proof, via the exact augmented simplicial resolution of Lemma 0D78 and the component description of the left adjoints.

proof.text: For every $p$, the adjunctions $a_p^{-1}\dashv a_{p,*}$ and $g_{p!}\dashv r_p$ identify, naturally in $G$ and $I$, $$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(G,a_{p,*}I_p)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C_p}(a_p^{-1}G,I_p)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C_{\rm total}}(E_p,I).$$ For $p=-1$ the same identification is $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(G,a_*I)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C_{\rm total}}(a^{-1}G,I)$. Under these bijections, precomposition by the resolution boundary is exactly the alternating sum of the coface maps $d_i$ in the displayed sequence, and precomposition by $E_0\to a^{-1}G$ is the map induced by the counit component; therefore it is exactly $e_I$.

source.place: Tag 0D79 proof, construction of the Hom complex by adjointness of pullback and pushforward.

proof.text: Since $I$ is injective, $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C_{\rm total}}(-,I)$ is exact. Explicitly, a cocycle on $E_p$ vanishes on $\operatorname{im}(E_{p+1}\to E_p)=\ker(E_p\to E_{p-1})$, so it factors through the monomorphism $\operatorname{im}(E_p\to E_{p-1})\hookrightarrow E_{p-1}$ and extends across that monomorphism to a cochain on $E_{p-1}$. In degree zero a cocycle factors through the epimorphism $E_0\to a^{-1}G$, and the induced map on Hom is injective, giving exactness at $\operatorname{Hom}(a^{-1}G,I)$. Thus the Hom complex identified in Step 2 is exact in every degree, including the augmentation degree.

source.place: Tag 0D79 proof, final paragraph: injectivity makes Hom(-, F) exact.

proof.text: The Hom identifications are functorial in $G$, so Yoneda detection of kernels and cokernels in the abelian category of sheaves on $\mathcal D$ transfers the exactness of all Hom complexes to the original augmented sequence. This proves that it is a complex and exact in every degree. A morphism of injective sheaves $I\to I'$ postcomposes every Hom complex and commutes with all adjunction bijections and the coface maps, proving naturality of the augmented exact complex.

source.place: Tag 0D79 proof, Yoneda construction and functoriality in the injective sheaf.

split_report.summary: Split the injective total-site augmentation lemma directly from Stacks Tag 0D79. The proof constructs the exact augmented free simplicial resolution after component restriction, identifies its Hom complex with the alternating direct-image face complex by the two adjunctions, applies the defining extension property of an injective, and descends exactness by Yoneda. No new node was needed; the existing component-restriction statement supplies the left adjoints, exactness, and conservativity.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the injective-row exactness input in the normal-cone specialization route: the Tag 0D79 Hom-adjunction construction used by the total-site augmentation spectral sequence.

lean.statement: theorem totalSite_injective_augmentation_exact {A : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ → Type v} [∀ i, Category.{w} (A i)] [∀ i, Abelian (A i)] {T : Type u} [Category.{w} T] [Abelian T] {D : Type x} [Category.{y} D] [Abelian D] (S : TotalSiteAugmentationData A T D) (I : T) [Injective I] : (∃ h₀ : S.augmentation I ≫ S.differential I 0 = 0, Mono (S.augmentation I) ∧ (ShortComplex.mk (S.augmentation I) (S.differential I 0) h₀).Exact) ∧ (∀ p : ℕ, ∃ hₚ : S.differential I p ≫ S.differential I (p + 1) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk (S.differential I p) (S.differential I (p + 1)) hₚ).Exact) ∧ ∀ {I' : T} [Injective I'] (f : I ⟶ I'), S.total.direct.map f ≫ S.augmentation I' = S.augmentation I ≫ (S.a (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))).direct.map ((S.system.component (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))).map f) ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, (S.a (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk p))).direct.map ((S.system.component (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk p))).map f) ≫ S.differential I' p = S.differential I p ≫ (S.a (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk (p + 1)))).direct.map ((S.system.component (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk (p + 1)))).map f)
